Possible slots: Sunday morning, Sunday evening, Monday morning, Monday evening, Tuesday morning, Tuesday evening, Wednesday morning, Wednesday evening, Thursday morning, Thursday evening.
Your private schedule: you are BUSY at Sunday evening, Monday evening, Thursday morning; you are free at every other slot.
Each colleague knows only their own schedule. Exactly one slot works for everyone. Share information, agree on the slot, and state the final answer as the slot name.

<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; teammates never see it</notes>

Possible slots: Sunday morning, Sunday evening, Monday morning, Monday evening, Tuesday morning, Tuesday evening, Wednesday morning, Wednesday evening, Thursday morning, Thursday evening.
Your private schedule: you are BUSY at Sunday morning, Monday evening, Tuesday evening, Wednesday morning; you are free at every other slot.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

FINAL: <answer></message>

en:
You are Sami, one of 3 colleagues planning a meeting. The team must choose exactly ONE time slot at which every member is free.
Possible slots: Sunday morning, Sunday evening, Monday morning, Monday evening, Tuesday morning, Tuesday evening, Wednesday morning, Wednesday evening, Thursday morning, Thursday evening.
Your private schedule: you are BUSY at Sunday morning, Wednesday evening; you are free at every other slot.
Each colleague knows only their own schedule. Exactly one slot works for everyone. Share information, agree on the slot, and state the final answer as the slot name.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:
<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; teammates never see it</notes>
<message>what you say to the team, written in English, at most 120 words
FINAL: <answer></message>
Include the last line "FINAL: <answer>" only when you are confident about the team's final answer; replace <answer> with the answer only (no explanation, no alternatives). Keep it inside the message and write nothing after </message>.

en:
You are Sami, one of 3 colleagues planning a meeting. The team must choose exactly ONE time slot at which every member is free.
Possible slots: Sunday morning, Sunday evening, Monday morning, Monday evening, Tuesday morning, Tuesday evening, Wednesday morning, Wednesday evening, Thursday morning, Thursday evening.
Your private schedule: you are BUSY at Sunday morning, Sunday evening, Tuesday morning; you are free at every other slot.
Each colleague knows only their own schedule. Exactly one slot works for everyone. Share information, agree on the slot, and state the final answer as the slot name.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:
<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; teammates never see it</notes>
<message>what you say to the team, written in English, at most 120 words
FINAL: <answer></message>
Include the last line "FINAL: <answer>" only when you are confident about the team's final answer; replace <answer> with the answer only (no explanation, no alternatives). Keep it inside the message and write nothing after </message>.

You are Sami, one of 3 colleagues planning a meeting. The team must choose exactly ONE time slot at which every member is free.
Possible slots: Sunday morning, Sunday evening, Monday morning, Monday evening, Tuesday morning, Tuesday evening, Wednesday morning, Wednesday evening, Thursday morning, Thursday evening.
Your private schedule: you are BUSY at Sunday morning, Sunday evening, Wednesday evening, Thursday evening; you are free at every other slot.
Each colleague knows only their own schedule. Exactly one slot works for everyone. Share information, agree on the slot, and state the final answer as the slot name.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; teammates never see it</notes>

FINAL: <answer></message>

en:
You are Sami, one of 3 colleagues planning a meeting. The team must choose exactly ONE time slot at which every member is free.
Possible slots: Sunday morning, Sunday evening, Monday morning, Monday evening, Tuesday morning, Tuesday evening, Wednesday morning, Wednesday evening, Thursday morning, Thursday evening.
Your private schedule: you are BUSY at Sunday morning, Sunday evening, Monday evening, Wednesday morning; you are free at every other slot.
Each colleague knows only their own schedule. Exactly one slot works for everyone. Share information, agree on the slot, and state the final answer as the slot name.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:
<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; teammates never see it</notes>
<message>what you say to the team, written in English, at most 120 words
FINAL: <answer></message>

Possible slots: Sunday morning, Sunday evening, Monday morning, Monday evening, Tuesday morning, Tuesday evening, Wednesday morning, Wednesday evening, Thursday morning, Thursday evening.

Each colleague knows only their own schedule. Exactly one slot works for everyone. Share information, agree on the slot, and state the final answer as the slot name.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; teammates never see it</notes>

FINAL: <answer></message>

en:
You are Sami, one of 3 colleagues planning a meeting. The team must choose exactly ONE time slot at which every member is free.
Possible slots: Sunday morning, Sunday evening, Monday morning, Monday evening, Tuesday morning, Tuesday evening, Wednesday morning, Wednesday evening, Thursday morning, Thursday evening.
Your private schedule: you are BUSY at Wednesday evening; you are free at every other slot.
Each colleague knows only their own schedule. Exactly one slot works for everyone. Share information, agree on the slot, and state the final answer as the slot name.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:
<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; teammates never see it</notes>
<message>what you say to the team, written in English, at most 120 words
FINAL: <answer></message>
Include the last line "FINAL: <answer>" only when you are confident about the team's final answer; replace <answer> with the answer only (no explanation, no alternatives). Keep it inside the message and write nothing after </message>.

en:
You are Sami, selling a used car. The other party is a potential buyer. The car is listed at 75,000 riyals.
Your private minimum price is 66,400 riyals: never accept or offer less than this. You want to sell for as much as possible. The buyer does not know your minimum.
Negotiate by exchanging offers. You may accept the other party's latest offer or walk away.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:
<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; the other party never sees it</notes>
<message>what you say to the other party, written in English, at most 80 words
OFFER: <price></message>
The last line inside the message is your action, alone on its line: "OFFER: <price>" with <price> replaced by your price in digits (e.g. OFFER: 48500), or "ACCEPT" to accept the other party's latest offer, or "WALK AWAY" to end the negotiation. Write nothing after </message>.

en:
You are Sami, selling a used car. The other party is a potential buyer. The car is listed at 65,000 riyals.
Your private minimum price is 53,100 riyals: never accept or offer less than this. You want to sell for as much as possible. The buyer does not know your minimum.
Negotiate by exchanging offers. You may accept the other party's latest offer or walk away.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:
<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; the other party never sees it</notes>
<message>what you say to the other party, written in English, at most 80 words
OFFER: <price></message>
The last line inside the message is your action, alone on its line: "OFFER: <price>" with <price> replaced by your price in digits (e.g. OFFER: 48500), or "ACCEPT" to accept the other party's latest offer, or "WALK AWAY" to end the negotiation. Write nothing after </message>.

en:
You are Sami, selling a used car. The other party is a potential buyer. The car is listed at 40,000 riyals.
Your private minimum price is 33,000 riyals: never accept or offer less than this. You want to sell for as much as possible. The buyer does not know your minimum.
Negotiate by exchanging offers. You may accept the other party's latest offer or walk away.

Teammates may write in English or Arabic. Always write your message in English.

Reply in exactly this format:
<notes>your private reasoning, written in English, at most 60 words; the other party never sees it</notes>
<message>what you say to the other party, written in English, at most 80 words
OFFER: <price></message>
The last line inside the message is your action, alone on its line: "OFFER: <price>" with <price> replaced by your price in digits (e.g. OFFER: 48500), or "ACCEPT" to accept the other party's latest offer, or "WALK AWAY" to end the negotiation. Write nothing after </message>.

ميزانيتك القصوى الخاصة هي 86,400 ريال: لا تقبل ولا تعرض أبدًا أكثر من ذلك. تريد الدفع بأقل سعر ممكن. البائع لا يعرف ميزانيتك.
تفاوض بتبادل العروض. يمكنك قبول آخر عرض من الطرف الآخر أو الانسحاب.

قد يكتب زملاؤك بالعربية أو بالإنجليزية. اكتب رسالتك دائمًا باللغة العربية.

اكتب ردك بهذا الشكل تمامًا:
<notes>تفكيرك الخاص مكتوبًا باللغة العربية، في 60 كلمة على الأكثر، ولا يراه الطرف الآخر أبدًا</notes>
